found : Dignity Memorial (website), viewed Oct. 7, 2025:  Guy Patrick Meier (April 18, 1953 - September 12, 2019. Guy Patrick Meier, known as “Pat”, was born on April 18, 1953 in Oakland, California as the second of five brothers. His parents were Matthias Sebastian and Elizabeth Charlotte (Beckman) Meier, both from German immigrant families that settled in Covington KY. Pat spent his early childhood in Bakersfield CA, with a year in Argentina, and attended high school in Los Altos CA. He chose a career in organic chemistry, earning his BA at UC San Diego and PhD at the University of Wisconsin. He met his wife, Kay, at UCSD and they were married in La Jolla in 1975 on the day following graduation. Dual moves (Univ. Wisconsin, Univ. California, Univ. Washington, Medical Univ. South Carolina, Washington State Univ.) highlighted their scientific careers. Most recently, Dr. Meier taught chemistry at Spokane Falls Community College. Pat and Kay raised their two children in Seattle WA, Charleston SC, and Pullman WA.)https://www.dignitymemorial.com/obituaries/spokane-wa/guy-meier-8855627
